statBlock.name: Animated Armor
statBlock.description: A suit of armor comes to life, often in a sentry post where it can pass for a decoration until it moves.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Iron Golem
statBlock.description: This metal guardian can stand watch for generations. Its magical core turns fire into a source of healing and lets it burn or poison intruders.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Fire Absorption. Exposure to fire damage restores HP equal to the fire damage dealt.
Immutable Form. The golem cannot change shape.
Magic Resistance. The golem rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Bladed Arm and Fiery Bolt.
Bladed Arm. Melee attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 20 (3d8 + 7) slashing damage and 10 (3d6) fire damage.
Fiery Bolt. Ranged attack, +10 to hit, range 120 ft. On a hit, deal 36 (8d8) fire damage.
Poison Breath (recharge 6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Constitution save against 55 (10d10) poison damage. A success halves the damage.
sections.Orders (1d4):
1. Block a door no one has opened until a prophecy comes true.
2. Vent poison whenever possible unless someone uses the password.
3. Keep still like a statue until the community truly needs help.
4. Stand guard over the place where a potent magic item lies.

statBlock.name: Clay Golem
statBlock.description: A sculpted guardian made from earth tied to the place it protects. It can keep its watch long after its creator dies.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Acid Absorption. Replace acid damage with healing equal to the amount of that damage.
Berserk. At the start of each of the golem's turns, if it is Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, it goes berserk. On its turns in that state, it attacks the nearest creature it can see. If it cannot move close enough to attack a creature, it attacks an object. The state ends when it is destroyed or stops being Bloodied.
Immutable Form. The golem cannot change shape.
Magic Resistance. The golem rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks. Make three if the golem used Hasten this turn.
Slam. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage and 6 (1d12) acid damage. Reduce the target's HP maximum by the acid damage it took.
sections.Bonus actions: Hasten (recharge 5–6). The golem takes both the Dash and Disengage actions.
sections.Orders (1d4):
1. Stop anyone entering with a weapon drawn.
2. Protect the creator's family or community when a threat is in sight.
3. Bar Fiends from crossing a bridge.
4. Remove visitors from the creator's workshop.

statBlock.name: Flesh Golem
statBlock.description: A maker animates a body assembled from several others. Fragments of the former lives sometimes surface in its behavior.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Aversion to Fire. Taking fire damage gives the golem Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks through the end of its next turn.
Berserk. At the start of each of the golem's turns, if it is Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, it goes berserk. On its turns in that state, it attacks the nearest creature it can see. If it cannot move close enough to attack a creature, it attacks an object. The state ends when it is destroyed or stops being Bloodied. Its creator can use an action within 60 ft. to try a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check, provided the golem can hear them. A success stops the frenzy through the start of the golem's next turn, when it rolls again if still Bloodied.
Immutable Form. The golem cannot change shape.
Lightning Absorption. Exposure to lightning damage restores HP equal to the lightning damage dealt.
Magic Resistance. The golem rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and 4 (1d8) lightning damage.
sections.Appearance (1d6):
1. Humanlike and animal parts stitched together.
2. Heavy clothing and makeup hide the seams.
3. Gaps in the body's assembly lie exposed.
4. Body parts serve unusual purposes, such as hands covering the torso.
5. Fine stitching frames nearly flawless features.
6. Visible bellows or other machinery move the body.

statBlock.name: Stone Golem
statBlock.description: These animated statues often guard tombs, sanctuaries, and monuments well after their makers are gone.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. The golem cannot change shape.
Magic Resistance. The golem rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Slam and Force Bolt.
Slam. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and 9 (2d8) force damage.
Force Bolt. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 120 ft. On a hit, deal 22 (4d10) force damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Slow (recharge 5–6). Cast Slow with no spell components. Use Constitution as its spellcasting ability, with a save DC of 17.
sections.Orders (1d6):
1. Admit only visitors in ceremonial clothing.
2. Cast Slow on anyone who touches the city's prized relic, then help capture them.
3. Break a particular dam or bridge when ordered by the holder of the ruler's medallion.
4. Obey whoever returns a lost crest to its chest, then shut down for a year.
5. Show the secret passage to anyone who repeats the ruler's final words.
6. Hunt the kind of monster that killed the hero the golem depicts.

statBlock.name: Helmed Horror
statBlock.description: A suit of animated armor with a soldier's judgment. It follows its maker's commands and can withstand spells its maker chose in advance.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned.
sections.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The horror rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Spell Immunity. Its creator chooses three spells to which it is immune. Heat Metal, Lightning Bolt, and Magic Missile are common choices.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Arcane Sword attacks.
Arcane Sword. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage and 5 (1d10) force damage.
sections.Directives (1d6):
1. Fly its master's palanquin to its destination.
2. Keep a treasure safe by fitting it into the armor.
3. Wear a missing or dead hero's gear and impersonate them.
4. Work as a servant or laborer.
5. Join a legion made from the armor of earlier defenders.
6. Stand guard among suits of mundane armor.

statBlock.name: Shield Guardian
statBlock.description: A magical bodyguard follows whoever wears its command amulet. It can shield that wearer from harm and hold a spell for later use.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands commands given in any language but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Bound. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane, the wearer can call it telepathically to the amulet. On that plane, the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. Whenever the wearer takes damage within 60 ft. of the guardian, transfer half that damage to the guardian, rounding up.
Regeneration. It begins each of its turns by regaining 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
Spell Storing. A spellcaster wearing the amulet can cast a spell of level 4 or lower on the guardian from within 5 ft. The spell takes no immediate effect and replaces any spell already stored. The guardian can later cast it with the original caster's parameters and spellcasting ability, without components. Casting uses up the stored spell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks.
Fist. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and 7 (2d6) force damage.
sections.Reactions: Protection. When an attack roll hits the amulet's wearer within 5 ft. of the guardian, give the wearer +5 AC until the start of the guardian's next turn. The bonus applies to the triggering attack and can cause it to miss.
